description: Every AVer USA manual, spec sheet, and white paper in a local, type-filtered catalog — with spec comparison and link audits no AVer site offers.

tools.name: docs_download
tools.description: Download an article's attached file (PDF). Required: entity-id.

params.name: entity-id
params.description: Salesforce entityId resolved from the article URL name (see docs sync)

tools.name: docs_get
tools.description: Fetch a knowledge article as clean text (crawler-UA SSR). Required: url-name.

params.name: url-name
params.description: Article URL name from the sitemap, e.g. CAM540-Manual

tools.name: docs_list
tools.description: Fetch the support-portal article sitemap (all knowledge-article URLs).

tools.name: products_get
tools.description: Fetch a product page as clean text (spec links, downloads). Required: category, model.

params.name: category
params.description: Product category slug, e.g. conference-camera, ptz-camera, document-camera, video-bar, charging-cart

params.name: model
params.description: Product model slug, e.g. cam570, vc520pro3, tr530

tools.name: products_list
tools.description: Fetch the main-site sitemap (product pages, categories).
